name: weather-1.0.0
description: Get current weather and multi-day forecasts for any location (no API key required)

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather conditions for a location including temperature, humidity, wind, UV index, cloud cover, and precipitation. Uses wttr.in for a quick summary and Open-Meteo for structured data. No API key needed.

location.description: Location name, city, or address (e.g. 'Greenwich, CT', 'New York City', 'JFK')

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get a multi-day weather forecast for a location with high/low temps, precipitation, wind, UV index, sunrise/sunset. No API key needed.

days.description: Number of days to forecast (1-10, default 5)
